name: pending-state-discard-fails-closed-and-unasserted
body: `run_pipeline`'s pending-state probe opens `db.lbug` read-only and fails closed, so an unopenable or locked database also forces the full load and discards the index — the safe direction (never seed from an unreadable database); upgrade only if a scan over a locked database should refuse instead of rebuilding. The new discard-and-rebuild branch also has no direct assertion until the scan/query recovery e2e (phase-4 task-11) lands; the unchanged unit/int gate covers the rest.
